title: Sticky Date Sponge Pudding
summary: A classic British dessert with a soft, caramel-scented sponge studded with dates and topped with warm toffee sauce. Best served fresh and hot, with a rich, comforting flavour.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and lightly butter a medium baking dish or 6 individual ramekins.
Put the chopped dates in a bowl, stir in the bicarbonate of soda, then pour over the boiling water and leave to soften for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and light brown sugar together until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then mix in the vanilla extract.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the softened date mixture until evenly combined.
Spoon the batter into the prepared dish or ramekins and smooth the top.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until risen, golden, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
While the sponge bakes, make the toffee sauce by heating the double cream, butter, brown sugar, syrup and vanilla in a small pan over low heat, stirring until smooth and glossy.
Serve the pudding warm, drizzled generously with the toffee sauce.
